handoffRows.owner_action: Paste the real client fields in wp-admin only, not into repo reports.
handoffRows.blocked_until: Owner/admin is in wp-admin and confirms the source reference.
handoffRows.safety: Leave release_to_router unchecked unless consent is explicit/owner-verified.

handoffRows.recommended_value: Leave routing_hold active; do not tick release_to_router; keep billing queue preparation on only as a future proof field.
handoffRows.owner_action: Create the record as held if approved.
handoffRows.blocked_until: Client gives explicit match permission and partner terms exist.
handoffRows.safety: The client is not introduced to anyone just because the lead exists.

handoffRows.recommended_value: Use current inbound permission/details wording from the consent message pack; ask for case details and explicit permission to match.
handoffRows.owner_action: Owner/legal approves and sends the message manually only if appropriate.
handoffRows.blocked_until: Client replies with clear permission or owner verifies existing permission evidence.

handoffRows.admin_location: Justice CRM -> Anonymized partner preview / terms queue
handoffRows.recommended_value: No-PII preview only: area=UK/cross-border law; source=/uk-lawyer/; urgency/details only if safe; ask availability, scope, SLA and fee.
handoffRows.owner_action: Use this after permission, before sending any name/phone/email/documents.
handoffRows.blocked_until: Permission evidence is recorded and routing_hold remains on.
handoffRows.safety: No screenshots, raw chat, exact phone, exact address or documents at preview stage.

handoffRows.admin_location: Supplier/lawyer profile + CRM partner terms queue
handoffRows.recommended_value: Record target_type=both or supplier/lawyer, terms_accepted, min fee, billing contact, response commitment and capacity limits.
handoffRows.owner_action: Register or complete at least one UK-law lawyer/supplier partner with accepted paid terms.
handoffRows.blocked_until: Accepted terms and billing contact are recorded.
handoffRows.safety: No PII release to a partner with missing fee or missing billing contact.

handoffRows.admin_location: Justice CRM -> Owner handoff release queue
handoffRows.recommended_value: approved_manual_handoff only after permission, accepted terms and fee are all recorded.
handoffRows.owner_action: Owner records the manual-only release decision.
handoffRows.blocked_until: Client permission + partner terms + owner release are present.
handoffRows.safety: Owner release records approval; the system still does not send anything automatically.

handoffRows.admin_location: Justice CRM -> Qualified lead billing queue
handoffRows.recommended_value: Move to ready_to_bill/invoice_sent/paid only with invoice reference or private payment evidence.
handoffRows.owner_action: Collect and store invoice/payment proof before claiming revenue.
handoffRows.blocked_until: Partner accepted fee and owner release happened for this lead.
handoffRows.safety: Do not mark paid or claim revenue without proof.

handoffRows.admin_location: Justice CRM -> WhatsApp / TalkTo connector readiness
handoffRows.recommended_value: Keep webhook/API automation not live for this lead.
handoffRows.owner_action: Use manual CRM path only until official provider route, signed payload/shared secret, pause control and permission text are approved.
handoffRows.safety: No WhatsApp Web/login automation, scraping, CAPTCHA/MFA bypass or unattended platform access.
